content.introduction: As of today, the Yahoo Finance Economic Sector Performance Dashboards show that the Technology sector leads with a YTD return of 31.45%, followed by Industrials at 48.35%. The Energy sector has the highest day return at +0.51%, while Utilities has the highest YTD return at -1.29%. The sources also indicate that the Technology sector had a day return of +0.01% and the Financial Services sector had a day return of +0.14%. The State Street Sector tracker provides additional data as of Oct 05, showing the Information Technology sector (xlk) with a day return of +0.56%.
